method: CSV export of the official VoteWA candidate list (ASP.NET postback), election GENERAL 2026, county Garfield
manual_export_steps: Election dropdown: choose 'GENERAL 2026 (11/03/2026) (General)' (option value 899); the page posts back
County dropdown: choose 'Garfield' (option value 12); the page posts back. Equivalent direct URL: https://voter.votewa.gov/candidatelist.aspx?c=12&e=899

Click the grid's 'Export to CSV' icon (input ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$grdCandidates$ctl00$ctl02$ctl00$ExportToCsvButton); the response is text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment;filename="CandidateList.csv"
scripted_export: python3 pipeline/fetch_votewa_candidate_list.py --election 2026-11-03-general --refresh --write-pointer garfield: GET the direct URL with a cookie jar, check the selected Election and County labels, then POST the form back to its action replaying every hidden input (__VIEWSTATE__, __VIEWSTATE, __EVENTVALIDATION, Telerik ClientState fields) and every <select> (selected option, else the first; ctl00$ddlLanguages='en-us'), plus ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$grdCandidates$ctl00$ctl02$ctl00$ExportToCsvButton=' '.
notes: Official county candidate filing data for the November 3, 2026 general. The 'Election Status' column is blank for every row in the general export, and the export lists only general-election candidates (top-two survivors of partisan and judicial primaries plus offices filed directly for the general). The CSV has no Ballot Order column; the grid's Ballot Order is HTML-only.
